entities.name: Gunārs Lūsis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gunārs Lūsis is a Latvian artist and graphical designer. Lūsis is notable for creating the design for some of the modern Latvian coins with denominations in Latvian lats, and for authoring the logo for the Latvian presidency of the Council of the European Union.
